notes: captained_national_team is a subproperty of played_for_national_team, neither functional in the catalogue. The record's presupposition (Messi represented one country at senior level) is a firm Func(played_for_national_team), as README allows for a one-value presupposition. Nationality is citizen_of with the country as the individual (surfaces 'France'/'French', 'Argentina'/'Argentine'); the class rules 'every player of the national team holds that nationality' are firm. 'La Pulga' is a placeholder identified with Messi by a firm bridge. q1 and related_far: related_far (the nickname of a national team) is not_checked: nicknamed is for persons and no relation for a team's nickname exists.

bridge_refs.pulga: 'La Pulga' is a nickname of Lionel Messi.

bridge_refs.france_rule: Every player of the France national football team holds French nationality.

background.france_rule: played_for_national_team value france ⊑ citizen_of value france
